(to the question) The first pregnancy
In the first pregnancy, the phase of the Katnut of ZA of Nekudim is corrected in return — that is, the six vessels: HBD, HGT, and the point of the Chazeh, in the level of NHY, which is the light of Nefesh. And it is called three within three, for only the three upper vessels are enlarged in the pregnancy, and the three lower ones are included in them. And at the end of the pregnancy, at the time of birth, AVI couple in the screen of phase 1, from the phase of their middle vessels, and the level of Ruach comes out for ZA; but ZA cannot receive it now, for it is born immediately and falls to BYA, and loses even the phase of the Nefesh of Atzilut. And through its nursing there from the lower two thirds of Atik, which left their record in the NHY of AA of Atzilut, it returns and acquires the Nefesh of Atzilut from the time of the pregnancy, and ascends from BYA and clothes the NHY of AA of Atzilut. (Part 1, Page 152, Item 85). See above, answer 24.
